QuestInfo.name: Birth of a New Hero
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Alliance finally wants you as a member! \r\nReturn to Ereve.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Alliance finally wants you as a member!  \r\nTalk to #bNeinheart#k in Ereve.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You're now a bonafide member of the Maple Alliance! \r\nYou can't wait to see what kind of adventures you'll experience alongside the heroes you've heard so many stories about!

yes.0: Come with me to the arena.\r\nWe mustn't keep our audience waiting.

no.0: Not ready yet?\r\nTalk to me when you are.

1.0: I hereby welcome you, #b#h0##k, into the Maple Alliance.\r\nI look forward to what your future holds.

yes.0: As a member of the Alliance, it is your duty to seek truth and justice wherever you go.
yes.1: The world is a big place.\r\nThere are many who need the Maple Alliance's help.\r\n
yes.2: Continue your travels. Continue your studies and learn to harness your power.\r\nI expect to hear great things about you.
yes.3: Congratulations, and welcome to the Maple Alliance.\r\nExpect me to call upon you when the Alliance needs your help.\r\n
yes.4: Oh, and before I forget; the Empress wanted you to have this.\r\nPlease use this in  your mission to help others.

default.0: Not everyone can become a member of the Maple Alliance.
